_comment: traps.md X5/X6 - placeholders with dosing instructions in Malayalam. '1 രാവിലെ, 1 രാത്രി' is 1 morning, 1 night. The printed date carries a time ('03-Oct-2019, 12:04 PM') which must be stripped before parsing rather than causing the date to fail.

provider._note: The prescriber name is redacted with a black bar; only a one or two letter fragment is legible. A fragment is not a usable name - which letters survive depends on where the bar lands - so this is null, consistent across all redacted headers.
